intro: Both are AI code editors. Cursor's pricing is now sold as part of X/Grok subscription tiers; windsurf.com/pricing now redirects to Devin's pricing page.
rows: Yes, $0: limited agent and chat requests

pick: Pick Cursor if you also want Grok chat, image and agent tools in one subscription. Pick Windsurf/Devin if you want a plain $20 coding plan with multi-vendor frontier models.
faq: Is Cursor free?
Yes. The Free plan is $0/month with limited agent and chat requests.
What happened to Windsurf pricing?
On Oct 15, 2026 windsurf.com/pricing redirected to devin.ai/pricing, which lists Free $0, Pro $20/month and Max $200/month.
Which is cheaper to start?
Cursor Plus is $8/month but only includes Grok models; Windsurf/Devin Pro is $20/month.

pick: Pick Cursor if you want a visual editor and a free tier. Pick Claude Code if you already pay for Claude and work in the terminal.
faq: Is Claude Code free?
No. Claude's pricing page lists Claude Code as included in Pro, Max and Team, not Free.
Does Claude Code share limits with Claude chat?
Yes. Anthropic says chats and Claude Code draw from one usage pool.
What is the cheapest way to try Cursor?
The Free plan at $0/month.

faq: Is ElevenLabs free?
Yes. Free gives 10k credits a month.
Can I use Suno songs commercially?
Suno's pricing page lists commercial rights on paid plans.
Does ElevenLabs make music?
Yes. Eleven Music uses about 900 credits per minute.

intro: Zapier charges per task (each successful step). n8n charges per full workflow execution and has a free self-hosted Community Edition.
pick: Pick Zapier for the most app connections and the easiest setup. Pick n8n for complex multi-step workflows, self-hosting or lower cost at volume.
faq: Is Zapier free?
Yes, 100 tasks a month with two-step Zaps.
Is n8n free?
The self-hosted Community Edition is free; n8n Cloud starts at €20/month billed annually.
What's the difference between a task and an execution?
Zapier counts each successful step; n8n counts one full workflow run, however many steps it has.
